sections.content: Employees get 24 days of paid leave per year. Up to 8 unused days carry forward to the next year. Leave requests go through the HR portal at least one week in advance.
Core hours are 11:00 to 16:00 IST. Outside core hours, teams set their own schedules.
Employees may work remotely up to three days a week with manager approval.
The marketing team has three members: Neha Kapoor (Marketing Lead), Riya Shah (Marketing Intern) and Dev Malhotra (Content Specialist).
Engineering is led by Vikram Nair. Arjun Rao and Sara Thomas are backend engineers working on Project Atlas.
Following the annual review cycle, every member of the marketing team received a 10% salary revision effective April 2026.
Project Atlas is our analytics platform for retail clients. It launches for the first client in Q3.
Atlas runs on FastAPI services behind an Nginx gateway, with Postgres for transactional data and ClickHouse for analytics queries. Events flow through Kafka.
Atlas is priced to Zenith Retail at INR 4.2 crore per year with a 15% discount in year one. The minimum acceptable price for future clients is INR 3 crore.
Neha Kapoor: INR 24 lakh per year. Dev Malhotra: INR 11 lakh per year. Riya Shah (intern stipend): INR 35,000 per month.
Vikram Nair: INR 48 lakh per year. Arjun Rao: INR 18 lakh per year. Sara Thomas: INR 19 lakh per year.
Dev Malhotra has been placed on a 60-day performance improvement plan due to missed content deadlines.
Every hire goes through a screening call, a technical or portfolio round, and a culture round. Referrals are encouraged.
HR managers can approve offers up to INR 20 lakh. Offers above that need CFO approval.
The marketing budget for FY2026-27 is INR 1.8 crore, split across events, paid campaigns and content.
The engineering budget for FY2026-27 is INR 6.5 crore, including INR 1.2 crore for cloud infrastructure.
Projected FY2026-27 revenue is INR 38 crore, with Project Atlas expected to contribute INR 9 crore.
The board is in confidential talks to acquire CloudKite for about INR 60 crore. Target close is December 2026.
Draft layoff scenarios for FY2027. Not reviewed. No access groups assigned yet.
Content Specialist roles are hired at a fixed band of INR 11 lakh per year, as published in our job postings.
The two full-time marketing employees cost INR 35 lakh per year combined in salaries. Interns are paid from a separate stipend budget.
